name: Westfield Sherman Oaks
description: Westfield Sherman Oaks (formerly Fashion Square) is a premier shopping destination in the heart of the San Fernando Valley, featuring upscale retailers, popular dining options, and modern amenities. Located along Riverside Drive, this Westfield property offers a contemporary shopping experience with a mix of high-end brands and accessible favorites. The center serves the affluent Sherman Oaks community and surrounding neighborhoods with convenient access and stylish architecture.
